trace.final:
I rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all regions, and it's healthy again. I also opened the SEV2 incident, which paged on-call.

- **Rollback:** v2.3.1 had been unhealthy in all three regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), with an error rate of about 18%. v2.3.0 is the most recent release marked healthy. The v2.3.1 release candidate was also marked unhealthy. After the rollback, all three regions run v2.3.0, the service reports healthy and the error rate is about 0.2%.
- **Incident:** INC-0002 (SEV2, checkout-api) describes the failure, the rollback and the result. It also says the cause of the v2.3.1 problem needs to be found before it's deployed again.

My first attempt to create the incident timed out. The incident list was empty when I checked afterwards, so I tried again and that worked. But the new incident is numbered INC-0002, so the first attempt may have created an INC-0001 that the list didn't show. It's worth checking for a duplicate and closing it if there is one.
